title: Setup: a position's same-named permission set is in force but invisible — the set's Assigned Users panel is empty and the position reads as granting nothing
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-02** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin; `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/position/sales_manager` and `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/permission/sales_manager`.
- **Steps:** open position `sales_manager`; open permission set `sales_manager`; sign in as Marta Quinn (holds only the `sales_manager` position, no `sys_user_permission_set` row).
- **Expected:** the position page's own text, "Positions don't grant data access on their own. Bind `sales_manager` to one or more Permission Sets", and its *Permission Sets* field (empty) describe what holders get; the permission set's *Assigned Users* lists who holds it.
- **Actual:** the position shows no bound set and says it grants nothing; the permission set shows "Assigned Users 0 — No users assigned yet". Yet Marta reads all 9 accounts, which only `sales_manager`'s `viewAllRecords` on `crm_account` gives. The platform binds a position to the permission set of the same name (recorded in `src/sales/sharing/demo-staffing.ts`, #1779). The same holds for `sales_rep` (Assigned Users lists only the tester's direct grant, not the two reps).
- **Evidence:** [`14-F-permset-sales-manager-assigned-users-empty.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/14-F-permset-sales-manager-assigned-users-empty.png), [`12-access-positions-detail.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/12-access-positions-detail.png), [`14-access-permission-sets-sales-rep.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/14-access-permission-sets-sales-rep.png); `GET /api/v1/data/crm_account` as Marta → 9 records.
- **class: b** (who holds View All is not visible to the admin). **Reach:** every admin of an app that relies on name-matched position bindings, HotCRM included.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `console` metadata pages for position and permission (Assigned Users / Permission Sets panels), against the name-matching binding in `plugin-security`.
- **Dedupe words:** implicit position binding, same-named permission set, assigned users empty, positions don't grant data access.

## Seat review

- **Seat's class:** a, not b. Nothing is granted that should not be. The gap is that an admin cannot see who holds the set. It is an audit-visibility defect.
- **Landing (seat review):** `plugin-security` serves no effective holders for an own-name position→set binding, and the console panels read only explicit bindings.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- "same-name position permission set" family: 8 + 6 hits in objectstack, 3 + 3 in objectui. Related: objectstack#24736 (open), where the delegated-admin gate misses the same own-name binding, a different consumer of the same rule. objectui#2382 (closed 2026-07-10) fixed explicit bindings only. **New.**

## The retirement, now 18.x (domain:services seat 2)

(「甲」 amended by the maintainer, `6303865025` on #6015: a narrowing that no conversion carries also ships now, in 18.x, as a BREAKING minor; no refusal waits for 19.0.)

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2200

The 18.x warning landed as PR #24988 (`f90ea677c`). What remains is the fold's retirement, per this card's decision `6290781571` (its 裁后执行 for 提前): HotCRM declares `permissionSets` on its five positions first (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2200), so the retirement revokes nothing; then the seat dispatches the retirement: the position-name request and `dropDeactivatedFoldedSets` removed, the warning re-pointed to 'not granted; declare permissionSets', and the delegation walk, explain and the collision gate follow. The gate wiring in `.github/workflows/lint.yml` makes that PR Tier H, a draft for the maintainer's approval.
